metadata.title: About
metadata.description: Learn why Bharosa Hai is building trust infrastructure for Indian professional services.

hero.title: We are building trust infrastructure for everyday professional services.
hero.copy: Bharosa Hai exists because finding dependable help for important legal, property, compliance and documentation work should not feel uncertain or informal.
hero.imageAlt: Professional team planning a service platform

story.title: A local problem that deserves a serious product.
story.copy: In many Indian cities, trusted professionals are found through references, WhatsApp forwards or trial and error. That leaves many customers unsure about credentials, timelines and documents.
story.imageAlt: Founders discussing growth roadmap in an office
items: Bring structure to document-heavy service categories

problem.title: Customers need confidence before they share sensitive work.
problem.copy: Legal papers, property information, tax details and government documents require a different level of care than generic service listings.

items.title: Unclear credentials
items.copy: Customers often cannot quickly verify whether a provider is qualified for the work.

items.title: Scattered communication
items.copy: Important instructions, documents and expectations get lost across calls and messages.

items.title: Low accountability
items.copy: Without a structured profile and review workflow, customers carry too much risk.

mission.title: Mission
mission.copy: Help Indian customers start important work with verified professionals and clear expectations.
mission.visionCopy: Become the trusted operating layer for high-trust local professional services across India.

values.title: The product principles guiding the MVP.

items.title: Trust before growth
items.copy: We would rather onboard fewer serious professionals than fill the platform with unverified profiles.

items.title: Clarity for customers
items.copy: Every workflow should explain what is needed, what happens next and who is responsible.

items.title: Respect for local work
items.copy: India’s service needs are local, relationship-driven and document-heavy.

items.title: Operational discipline
items.copy: Verification, admin review and audit trails are core product surfaces from the MVP stage.

items.title: Premium but practical
items.copy: The experience should feel polished without losing the directness Indian customers expect.

items.title: Built for expansion
items.copy: The Tier 1 MVP stays focused while leaving room for future customer workflows.

philosophy.title: Verification should feel visible, not mysterious.
philosophy.copy: A badge only matters when the process behind it is clear. The first release makes provider status, document checks and admin decisions part of the system.
philosophy.imageAlt: Documents and credentials on a professional desk

items.title: Collect the right details
items.copy: Ask for professional information that matters to a customer decision.

items.title: Review documents
items.copy: Use category-specific requirements for lawyers, CAs, GST consultants and property advisors.

items.title: Make status explicit
items.copy: Pending, approved, rejected and needs-more-documents states are built into the model.

items.title: Keep an audit trail
items.copy: Admin decisions should be explainable as the product matures.

roadmap.title: A focused path from Tier 1 to a broader marketplace.

items.title: Tier 1 MVP
items.copy: Public website, provider registration, provider dashboard, admin dashboard and client access coming-soon surface.

items.title: Verified network
items.copy: Approve the first serious providers and tighten onboarding quality.

items.title: Customer workflow
items.copy: Launch request intake and matching after provider quality is strong enough.

items.title: City expansion
items.copy: Add more cities only after operational playbooks are repeatable.

founder.title: A note from the founding team.
founder.quote: Bharosa Hai is being built for the kind of work people cannot afford to get wrong. The first version is intentionally focused: create a trusted provider base, make the experience feel premium and earn confidence before expanding customer workflows.
